Buddy has a continuous curved back and tucked haunch, his chin and forepaws supported by the sofa cushion. Hidden limbs remain plausibly occluded within the compact curl rather than detached or duplicated.
findings.coat_and_grooming: Neet has a smooth fawn silhouette and short coat; fine low-contrast surface variation does not form long curled or engraved strands. Buddy has a close dark body bounded by a smooth back and tucked haunch, with lighter brows, moustache, beard and pendant ear furnishings localized to the face. Cushion texture is visibly separate from both coats.
findings.scene_and_comedy: The floor dog bed is beside the human bed and Neet looks upward toward the resting human hand; Buddy already occupies the separate sofa-bed. Their contrasting appeals and settled posture fit the storm-nap sequence before Neet jumps back onto the bed. Curtains and warm bedside lighting support the sheltered room. Human likeness is provisional.
findings.perspective_and_finish: Distinct bed, sofa and floor planes carry the figures without floating or merged furniture contacts. No material limb ownership or finish defect observed.
